Die Suchthilfe Region Basel ist eine der grössten privaten Trägerschaften im Raum Basel. Zu unseren Angeboten zählen Prävention, Beratung, Suchtbehandlung und Schadenminderung in der Suchthilfe. Die ESTA – Klinik für Suchtbehandlung in Reinach begleitet Menschen mit Abhängigkeitserkrankungen auf ihrem Weg in ein suchtfreies Leben. Wir bieten ein vielseitiges Behandlungsangebot im Entzugs- und Therapiesetting und legen grossen Wert auf eine professionelle, wertschätzende und individuelle Betreuung. Im Rahmen unserer Neuausrichtung entwickeln wir unser Behandlungskonzept gezielt weiter und richten unser Angebot künftig verstärkt auf Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene ab 16 Jahren aus. La regione Addiction Aid di Basilea è una delle più grandi sponsorizzazioni private della zona di Basilea. I nostri servizi includono la prevenzione, la consulenza, il trattamento della dipendenza e la riduzione del danno nella cura della dipendenza. L'ESTA – Clinica per il trattamento delle addizioni in Reinach accompagna le persone con malattie della dipendenza nel loro cammino verso una vita priva di dipendenza. The Addiction Aid Region Basel is one of the largest private sponsorships in the Basel area. Our services include prevention, counselling, addiction treatment and harm reduction in addiction care. The ESTA – Clinic for Addiction Treatment in Reinach accompanies people with addiction diseases on their way to an addiction-free life. We offer a versatile range of treatments in withdrawal and therapy setting and attach great importance to professional, appreciative and individual care. As part of our reorientation, we are further developing our treatment concept in a targeted manner and will increasingly focus our services on adolescents and young adults over the age of 16. You have the opportunity to actively shape the further development of our clinic, to contribute new ideas and to implement innovative treatment approaches together with a committed team. To complement our care team, we are looking for a motivated and committed personality immediately or by agreement. Care specialist HF/FH or health specialist 60-80% (m/f/d) Your main task area

• Accompaniment and care of patients during qualified withdrawal

Various Substance-Related Dependence Diseases

• Supporting patients in coping with their everyday lives and promoting their

Self-employment and personal resources

• Building and shaping a professional, sustainable therapeutic relationship as

Basis for trustful cooperation

• Observation of the physical and mental state and early recognition of

Changes and possible withdrawal complications

• Professional drug delivery according to medical orders and monitoring of

Effect and possible side effects

• Carrying out nursing and medical activities

• Co-creation of a safe, structured and appreciative treatment framework

• Close interdisciplinary cooperation with the medical, therapeutic and nursing

Team

• Professional documentation of the care course and active participation in the

Further development of the quality of care and internal clinic workflows.

• Actively contribute ideas and experiences to the further development of our

Treatment concept for adolescents and young adults

• Completed training as a nurse HF/FH or specialist Health

EFZ or equivalent recognised training

• Ideally, work experience in psychiatry, addiction medicine or in a comparable

Subject area

• Empathy, patience and a professional, resource-oriented attitude

• interest in addiction work and in accompanying people with

Addiction diseases

• The joy of building therapeutic relationships and the individual accompaniment of our

Patients*

• Responsibility, independent working methods and the ability to work in

challenging situations to act calmly and deliberately

• Enjoying teamwork and constructive interdisciplinary collaboration

• Willingness to work on shifts and on weekends and public holidays

• Openness to new ideas and interest in professional and personal

Further development We offer

• A versatile and demanding activity in a collegial and interdisciplinary

Working environment

• A dedicated team that supports each other and respects each other

• The opportunity to actively shape the future orientation of ESTA and to

Implementation of an innovative treatment concept for young adults

• Space for own ideas, professional development and the co-creation of work processes

• Internal training and supervision

• Five weeks of holidays

• An additional child support allowance in the case of entitlement to child support allowances

We look forward to your electronic application documents to our co-team management at jennifer.vonderheyden@suchthilfe.ch or jan.gloor@suchthilfe.ch. For questions, the co-nursing service Jennifer Von der Heyden and Jan Gloor is available at 061 706 87 87.

La région d'aide à la toxicomanie de Bâle est l'un des plus grands sponsors privés de la région de Bâle. Nos services comprennent la prévention, le counseling, le traitement de la toxicomanie et la réduction des méfaits des soins de toxicomanie. L'ESTA – Clinic for Addiction Treatment in Reinach accompagne les personnes atteintes de maladies liées à la toxicomanie sur le chemin d'une vie sans dépendance. «Fakten statt Moralpredigt, Labor statt Bauchgefühl und Selbstverantwortung statt Bevormundung» Du berätst Freizeitkonsumierende im Drug Checking, Menschen mit Substanzgebrauch im Beratungszentrum und gestaltest von Anfang an mit uns die DIBS als Kompetenzzentrum für Freizeitdrogenkonsum mit. Wir suchen per 01. Februar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung ein*e Sozialarbeiter*in im Drug Checking und Beratungszentrum (50%) – mit Perspektive auf Erhöhung des Pensums ab 2028 Das Beratungszentrum ist eines von mehreren, professionellen und eng miteinander vernetzten Angeboten der Stiftung Suchthilfe Region Basel. Das Beratungszentrum ist zuständig für die Beratung und Begleitung von suchtgefährdeten und suchtmittelabhängigen Personen von Jung bis Alt und deren Umfeld. Die DIBS (Drogeninfo Basel) ist das ambulante Drug-Checking-Angebot der Suchthilfe Region Basel. Seit 2019 ermöglicht sie als Teil des Beratungszentrums jeweils die Abgabe von psychoaktiven Substanzen, verbunden mit einem persönlichen Beratungsgespräch. Ergänzt wird das Angebot durch Safer Dance Basel als Nightlife- und Schadensminderungsangebot für Freizeitkonsumierende mit aufsuchender Arbeit im Nachtleben, in Clubs und an Festivals sowie mobilem Drug Checking vor Ort. Auftraggebende sind die Kantone Basel-Stadt und Basel-Landschaft. Gemeinsam vermitteln die Angebote sachliche und fundierte Informationen zu Wirkungen, Risiken und möglichen Folgeschäden des Konsums psychoaktiver Substanzen. Dabei stehen eine akzeptierende Haltung, die Förderung von Risikokompetenz und die Unterstützung selbstbestimmter Entscheidungen im Zentrum. Im Übergangsjahr 2027 werden die noch getrennten Angebote DIBS und Safer Dance Basel zusammengeführt und ab 2028 als «Kompetenzzentrum für Freizeitdrogenkonsum» weitergeführt. “Fatti invece della predicazione morale, laboratorio al posto della sensazione di fegato e della responsabilità di sé invece del paternalismo” Si consiglia agli utenti ricreativi nel controllo della droga, persone con uso di sostanza nel centro di consulenza e ci aiutano a progettare DIBS come centro di competenza per uso di droga ricreativo fin dall'inizio. Siamo alla ricerca di un assistente sociale presso il Drug Checking and Counselling Centre (50%) a partire dal 1° febbraio 2027 o per accordo – al fine di aumentare il carico di lavoro dal 2028 Il Centro di Consulenza è una delle numerose offerte, professionali e strettamente in rete della Fondazione Addiction Help Region Basel. Il centro di consulenza è responsabile per consigliare e accompagnare le persone a rischio di tossicodipendenza e di dipendenza da tossicodipendenti da giovani a anziani e dal loro ambiente. DIBS (Drogeninfo Basel) è il servizio di controllo della droga ambulatoriale della regione di Addiction Assistance di Basilea. L'attenzione è rivolta ad un atteggiamento di accoglienza, alla promozione della competenza del rischio e al sostegno delle decisioni autodeterminate. Nell’anno transitorio 2027, le offerte ancora separate DIBS e Safer Dance Basel saranno unite e dal 2028 in poi proseguiranno come “centro di eccellenza per il consumo di droga ricreativo”. “Facts instead of moral preaching, laboratory instead of gut feeling and self-responsibility instead of paternalism” You advise recreational users in drug checking, people with substance use in the counselling center and help us design DIBS as a competence center for recreational drug use right from the start. We are looking for a social worker at the Drug Checking and Counselling Centre (50%) as of 1 February 2027 or by agreement – with a view to increasing the workload from 2028 The Counselling Centre is one of several, professional and closely networked offers of the Foundation Addiction Help Region Basel. The counselling centre is responsible for advising and accompaniing people at risk of addiction and addiction-dependent persons from young to old and their environment. DIBS (Drogeninfo Basel) is the outpatient drug checking service of the Addiction Assistance Region Basel. Since 2019, as part of the counselling centre, it has made it possible to dispense psychoactive substances in conjunction with a personal consultation.
